title: TLS/SSL Certificate Name Mismatch on www.aniket.app (ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID)
evidence: Direct TLS connection to www.aniket.app fails verification. Served certificate only contains Subject Alternative Name (SAN): 'DNS:aniket.app'. It lacks 'www.aniket.app'. Any user, external backlink, or Googlebot crawl accessing https://www.aniket.app triggers a fatal SSL security error before HTTP redirection can execute.
rootCause: Vercel custom domain configuration is missing the www.aniket.app domain entry, or Let's Encrypt certificate renewal was completed for the apex domain only without adding the www alias.
recommendedFix: In Vercel Project Dashboard -> Settings -> Domains, add "www.aniket.app" and configure it to "Redirect to aniket.app". Vercel will provision an SNI-compliant dual-SAN TLS certificate covering both aniket.app and www.aniket.app.

title: Duplicate Homepage Served on /index.html without 308 Permanent Redirect
evidence: Direct GET https://aniket.app/index.html returns HTTP 200 OK (Content-Length: 39KB) instead of redirecting to /
rootCause: Vercel static file routing directly serves index.html from the repository root before Next.js routing takes effect, creating split-URL duplicate indexation and dilution of homepage PageRank.
recommendedFix: Add a permanent 308 redirect from /index.html to / in apps/web/next.config.mjs redirects() configuration and vercel.json.

title: Valid Public Pages Discovered via Links but Missing from XML Sitemaps
evidence: 22 public 200 OK page(s) (e.g., https://aniket.app/author/aniket-thakur.html, https://aniket.app/contact.html, https://aniket.app/work.html) are accessible via links but not registered in sitemap.xml.
rootCause: Sitemap generation script tools/seo/sitemap-builder.js omits certain static routes or research articles.
recommendedFix: Update sitemap-builder.js to automatically include all published research papers, topics, and native routes.

title: High Volume of Weakly Connected Pages (In-Degree = 1) Vulnerable to Crawl Drops
evidence: 308 pages rely on exactly 1 inbound internal link. Any change in pagination or archive drops them into orphan status.
rootCause: Deep content relies solely on chronological pagination rather than robust semantic topic clusters and cross-category hubs.
recommendedFix: Implement automated contextual "Related Articles in this Series" widgets linking to at least 3-4 thematic sibling articles.

title: Page Title Tags Exceeding Recommended SERP Display Limit (65 characters)
evidence: 150 page(s) have title tags exceeding 65 characters (e.g., "Graph Neural Networks for Ecological Trophic Dynamics — Aniket Thakur" - 69 chars), causing Google SERP truncation.
rootCause: Template appends long brand qualifiers or overly verbose headline phrasing to the title tag.
recommendedFix: Trim title tags to 50-60 characters, keeping primary keywords at the front and concise branding at the end.

title: High Server Response Latency (TTFB > 1200ms)
evidence: 1 page(s) exhibited Time To First Byte (TTFB) exceeding 1200ms (e.g. https://aniket.app/blog/auto/access-125-vs-activa-125-daily-scooter-comparison/: 1229ms).
rootCause: Cold-start edge cache misses or heavy dynamic computation during SSR rendering.
recommendedFix: Implement edge cache warming or convert static informational routes into pre-rendered static ISR with aggressive Cache-Control s-maxage.
